text:
carla (eng-platform): Quick FYI — we're starting a planning thread for the CI runner regional split + github org billing isolation. Goal: reduce cross-region egress, give EMEA/APAC teams local capacity, and allow org-level billing. Kickoff doc draft below, want feedback from SRE/security/devex before we lock timelines.

ben (devex): sounds good. can we keep the rollout in 3 phases? staging runners, then migrated infra repos, then repo moves. this reduces blast radius.

nia (eng-sre): agreed. need a clear drain + cordon plan for runners to avoid running jobs mid-move. example drain command we use: `./runner-drain --graceful --label region=emea`

vik (eng-security): we also must rotate the GitHub App installation tokens when we create separate orgs. will send a lockfile checklist for secrets and OIDC client configs.

alice (infra): note about infra: some of our self-hosted runner AMIs have hardcoded region endpoints for metrics. I'll open a tiny PR to parameterize endpoints so we can reuse AMIs across regions.

carla (eng-platform): early asks: 1) devex to provide migration playbook + sample GH Actions workflow changes; 2) sres to propose drain/cordon commands and metrics gating; 3) security to outline token rotation timeline; 4) infra to list AMI/cfn changes. Target: share final plan by EOD next Wednesday.

ben (devex): I'll mock a minimal workflow diff to show `runs-on` and runner labels, e.g.:
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, region-emea]
```
That plus an environment variable switch should be enough for most services to opt in.

sam (product): quick question — will feature flags be required for any customer-facing regions (we may need to notify customers)?

nia (eng-sre): for now no customer-visible flags. this is infra-only; if latency buckets change we may communicate. we'll add a monitoring dashboard before the cutover.

vik (eng-security): checklist (high level):
- create target orgs and invite SSO groups
- rotate GH App tokens and update installations
- update OIDC audience and verifier list in auth config
- run a permission audit on migrated repos
I'll post a detailed timeline after a quick dependency call.

carla (eng-platform): one more thing — webhook URLs will change for a couple of automation bots (notably deploy-bot). @deploy-bot can you post the webhook health check we can run post-move?

deploy-bot: webhook-check: POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/ci-health -> expect 200 + {"ok":true}. Running now... 200 OK.

alice (infra): tagging two infra concerns: 1) cross-account permissions for runner instances (IAM roles) need to be scoped per-org; 2) cost allocation tags will need to be enforced at provisioning. I'll add these to the infra workstream.

ben (devex): also plan to add a short migration guide for teams with long-lived runners (docker-in-docker caches etc). will include how to move caches with rsync and a TTL-based cleanup policy.

carla (eng-platform): thanks everyone. I'll collate responses into the kickoff doc and ping on calendar for a 30m sync Monday 9am PT. If you have blockers before then drop them here. :thumbsup:

vik (eng-security): one blocker: org creation requires legal signoff for billing accounts for a couple customers using dedicated contracts. I'll follow up offline.

nia (eng-sre): noted — we'll add a delay buffer in the rollout plan for legal/billing holdouts.

carla (eng-platform): perfect. saving this thread into the project board under "infra -> ci migration". will update the timeline there.

ben (devex): +1, will draft the playbook today.

carla (eng-platform): closing the loop — expect the planning doc link in #eng-platform by EOD.

sam (product): thanks team — appreciate the coordination.
